rules: BANNED FONTS: Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk
Use Outfit for all headings (H1-H6), navigation links, and critical numerical values like Total Portfolio Balance
Use Manrope for all body text, paragraphs, lists, table data, and input fields
Headings should have tight tracking (tracking-tight) to look premium
Numbers in tables and financial readouts should use the tabular-nums utility to ensure aligned decimal points
Strictly avoid gradients, glassmorphism, and neon effects. Stick to flat, solid colors.
Use clean solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders (#E3E3E3) for definition.
Shadows should be extremely subtle (shadow-sm or none), mostly relying on borders to separate cards from the #FFFFFF background.
Card border radius: use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for a premium, friendly but professional look.
Avatars and buttons should be pill-shaped (rounded-full) or match card radius (rounded-xl).

feed_card.description: The main unit of the social feed. Contains user info, thesis text, media, and the embedded position disclosure.
feed_card.layout: flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 md:p-6 bg-white border border-[#E3E3E3] rounded-2xl
elements: Header: Avatar, Name (Outfit, font-semibold), Timestamp, Ticker tags (e.g. $THYAO) with #E6E2FD bg and #7361F7 text
Body: Plain text of the investment thesis (Manrope)
Hero Feature: Position Disclosure Card (if attached) rendered immediately below the text
Footer: Like, Comment, Share actions (lucide-react icons, #72777F text, hover to #171717)

position_disclosure_card.description: The HERO feature. Embedded inside a post to show 'skin in the game'.
position_disclosure_card.layout: flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between p-4 bg-[#F1F5F7] rounded-xl border border-[#E3E3E3] gap-2 md:gap-0
data_points: Durum (Status Badge): ↑ Artırdı (Increased in green), ↓ Azalttı (Reduced in red), Kapatıldı (Closed in gray)
position_disclosure_card.styling: Use font-medium for the percentages. The status badge should use the positive/negative colors subtly (e.g. text-[#12BD57] with bg-[#E1F4F1] for 'Artırdı').

portfolio_dashboard.description: High-level view of user's BIST portfolio.
portfolio_dashboard.layout: Bento grid style on desktop, stacked flex-col on mobile. Add p-6 to cards.
widgets: Total Balance Card: Massive typography (Outfit text-4xl or 5xl), daily P&L below it in green/red
Performance Chart: Recharts LineChart. Use flat solid stroke with #35C7B2. NO gradients.
Holdings Table: Clean rows, left-aligned ticker symbol in bold Outfit, right-aligned monetary values in Manrope.

transaction_form.styling: Distinct label+input pairs. Input bg #FFFFFF, border #E3E3E3. Focus ring should be 2px solid #35C7B2. Buy action button in #35C7B2, Sell action button in #7361F7 or #FF3B30.

mobile_bottom_nav.description: Fixed navigation at the bottom for mobile screens.
mobile_bottom_nav.styling: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-[#E3E3E3] h-16 flex justify-around items-center z-50. Active tab uses #35C7B2 for icon and text, inactive uses #72777F.

styling: Use #35C7B2 for positive trend lines, #FF3B30 for negative trend lines.
CartesianGrid should use #E3E3E3 with strokeDasharray='3 3' or be completely hidden for a cleaner look.
X/Y axis text should use #72777F, text-xs, Manrope.
Tooltip must be a flat card with #FFFFFF bg, #E3E3E3 border, no gradients, and light shadow-sm.

icons.usage: Use 20px or 24px size. Stroke width 1.5 or 2 for a delicate, modern premium feel.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Always use 'data-testid' on interactive elements for robust automated testing.
Mobile-first architecture: Build layouts starting from base Tailwind classes, using md: and lg: for larger screens.
Do NOT use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform) to avoid breaking transforms.
Avoid generic centered text across the app. Left-align text for better reading flow, especially for data grids and financial metrics.
Strictly avoid backdrop blur or glassmorphism. Use opaque backgrounds with crisp 1px borders.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns/headers. Use #FFFFFF with a 1px border and a subtle shadow.
instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON and implement the exact requested colors in Tailwind config.
Import Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts and apply them as directed.
Build a modern, clean, light-themed Turkish financial platform.
Prioritize the HERO feature: the Position Disclosure card embedded in the social feed.
Ensure all user-facing copy is in Turkish.
Strictly avoid dark mode, gradients, glassmorphism, and neon styles.
